def get_item_stats(*, session: Session, owner_id: uuid.UUID | None = None) -> ItemsStats:
    """Count items and find the newest title; all items when owner_id is None."""
    count_statement = select(func.count()).select_from(Item)
    newest_statement = (
        select(Item.title)
        .order_by(col(Item.created_at).desc(), col(Item.id).desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    if owner_id is not None:
        count_statement = count_statement.where(Item.owner_id == owner_id)
        newest_statement = newest_statement.where(Item.owner_id == owner_id)
    count = session.exec(count_statement).one()
    newest_title = session.exec(newest_statement).first()
    return ItemsStats(count=count, newest_title=newest_title)
EOF
